title: R3 · review fixes
changes: Smoothed the traced edges (0.4 mm rounding) and simplified the outline.
Blade slots turned to the photo's slant, made 2.6 mm long; the last one is smaller.
Tip rounded; blade dot cut to 17 px (3.4 mm).
One hole enlarged, a missed hole added, three small bar holes made ovals.
Removed the visible placeholder pivot bore: the photo shows the hook lip solid.
Thickness 12 to 10 mm, with a short chisel bevel at the tip.
review: Thickness profile is wrong: the photos show a blade about as thick as it is wide, wedging down from the black dot over the last third. Model was a flat 10 mm plate with a short bevel.
Tip overshot into a wide round dome; the photo narrows to a small point on the outer edge.
Head honeycomb reads sparse and the small oval looks like an artifact.
Slots too thin (3.5:1); the photo's are fat ovals, about 2:1.
Hard jog in the outer edge where the blade starts; the photo is a smooth blend.
